title: 12 Best Viewpoints in Almaty
description: Discover the 12 best viewpoints in Almaty, Kazakhstan, offering breathtaking panoramas of cityscapes and majestic mountains. From iconic Kok Tobe to serene Big Almaty Lake, find your perfect view.

places.name: Kok Tobe Hill
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Panoramic city view from the observation deck, especially stunning at dusk when the city lights twinkle.

places.name: Medeu High-Mountain Skating Rink
places.priceRange: Cable car to Shymbulak starts 5000 KZT (~$11), Entrance to Medeu (rink access in winter) 1800 KZT (~$4)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The sheer scale of the mountains surrounding the valley, especially from the dam above the rink.

places.name: Shymbulak Ski Resort (Talgar Pass)
places.priceRange: Cable car round trip from Medeu 5000-9500 KZT (~$11-21)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The panoramic views from Talgar Pass, offering a true sense of the grandeur of the Tien Shan mountains.

places.name: Big Almaty Lake
places.priceRange: National Park entry 480 KZT (~$1), Taxi/private transfer 8000-15000 KZT (~$18-33) round trip
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The vivid turquoise color of the lake against the backdrop of snowy peaks like Ozerny, Sovetov, and Tourist.

places.name: First President's Park
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The wide-open space offering an unobstructed view of Almaty's low-rise cityscape against the towering Tien Shan.

places.name: Butakovskoye Gorge
places.priceRange: Free (National Park entry if going deep: 480 KZT ~$1)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tranquility and natural beauty of the forest trails, with rewarding viewpoints overlooking parts of the gorge and the city in the distance.

places.name: Mount Furmanov
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The unparalleled expansive views from the summit, showcasing the vastness of the Tien Shan and Almaty below.

places.name: Tien Shan Astronomical Observatory
places.priceRange: Free to visit the area; guided tours/stargazing events may have fees ~5000 KZT (~$11)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The combination of pristine mountain vistas during the day and unparalleled dark sky views for astronomy at night.

places.name: Alma-Arasan Gorge
places.priceRange: Free (National Park entry if going deeper: 480 KZT ~$1)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The tranquil river and dense forest scenery, perfect for a refreshing escape without a strenuous hike.

places.name: Gorelnik Waterfall
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The powerful main waterfall and the fresh, invigorating atmosphere of the gorge.

places.name: Vista Restaurant & Bar at The Ritz-Carlton Almaty
places.priceRange: ~25000-50000 KZT per person (~$55-110) for a meal/drinks
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Unrivaled high-rise views of the city, perfectly framed by the mountains, combined with exquisite service and ambiance.

places.name: Peak Molodezhny (Youth Peak)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The ultimate high-altitude panoramic view from a summit, encompassing glaciers, multiple peaks, and distant valleys.
